label: prf:stable-atom-decidable
title: Proof of stable atom decidable
html:
1. Compute the normal form T_w \in H_{n(K)}(q) via Gröbner–Shirshov reduction (hecke normal form). This terminates in finite time by the Diamond Lemma.
  2. Compute the confinement level (confinement level) \ell(K, q). Sort the finite set of shadow prices and find the smallest \ell such that T_w \in J^\ell(q).
  3. Construct the LP-dual constraint matrix \mathrm{G}(q) \in R^{N \times N}, where N is the number of primitive operators in J^{\ell(K, q)}(q). This set is finite by confinement-level-exists.
  4. Read off the coefficient vector x(K, q) of T_w in the primitive basis, check that it lies in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}^N, and evaluate the N coordinates of \mathrm{G}(q)\,x(K, q). Over a ring with decidable order this is a finite computation.

Each step is decidable. Their composition is decidable. \square

Complexity. The bottleneck is step 1, the normal-form reduction. Step 4 is one matrix-vector product of size N. No integer-programming search is needed, because the vector being tested is fixed by T_w.
